summary: Your site has a real team, a CEO message and WhatsApp links, but dead buttons and placeholder text sit exactly where buyers and sellers want to act.

findings.problem: Buy a property, Sell a property and Get a consultation point to #. The menu parents Rent & Sale, Services and Academy also point to #.
findings.cost: These are your main money buttons, and a dead button loses the lead.
findings.fix: Every key button linked to a real page or form.

findings.problem: A popup says Our Spring Sale Has Started, includes a developer note (You can see how this popup was set up in our step-by-step guide) and gives no offer.
findings.cost: A leftover note in front of customers looks careless.
findings.fix: A real offer or no popup.

findings.problem: The reviews section shows only image frames and a Leave a Review link, with no written testimonials.
findings.cost: Buyers and sellers want proof from past clients.
findings.fix: A live review wall and case results.

findings.problem: Placeholder text such as image () and Frame (), a title ending in IMTIAZ R, an odd long dash inside the word off-plan, and a dropdown reading 1st of the month15th of the month.
findings.cost: Small errors across the page cost credibility with investors.

redesign: Working buy, sell and consultation paths with a short form and WhatsApp.
A live review wall, case results and clean, proofread property pages.
